notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least two.
description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Nyx Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
